notes: Independent subsidiary of NIBE (acquired 2014, per page history). Style 1 (Building Center Style 1) ships YEAR-ONLY: year positions are text-verified (2018), but its month is HELD by coordinator decision — the spaced example '18 0100228' yields October under normalized counting but January under space-counted positions, with no page-stated decode to falsify either; doubtful stays held, pending image-pass confirmation on WaterFurnace-HVAC-style-1.jpg. Style 2 (Building Center Style 2, 1985-2012) is HELD entirely: year (1st character) and month (2nd character) are chart-only. The shipped file style-2 is Building Center Style 3 (pre-1985), year-only: its month (1st character) is chart-only.

styles.era: Current as of at least 2012, 9-digit numeric serials (Building Center Style 1)
styles.notes: Page positions 1-based: year = 1st & 2nd positions, month = 4th & 5th positions. COORDINATOR HOLD (supersedes slice report): month HELD, file ships year-only for this style. The page example is shown spaced as '18 0100228': normalized counting gives month '10' (October) but space-counted positions 4-5 give '01' (January), and no page-stated decode falsifies either reading, so the month is doubtful and stays held per program rule (image-pass check on WaterFurnace-HVAC-style-1.jpg may confirm the green month segment; if it shows '01', the hold stands, since the schema cannot express space-counted positions). Year is unaffected (2018 under both readings). Year value derived from the stated positions, not page-stated for this example.
